operator_contract.no_eval: Interpret this finite typed AST; never eval generator strings.
operator_contract.eq_and_in: Unknown operand -> unknown. Known equality/membership produces ordinary true/false.
operator_contract.is_known: Metadata test only; unknown/missing -> false. Must not be used to infer an opposite gameplay state.
operator_contract.selection_not_true: Layout-only conservative selection test: true->false, false/unknown->true. Does not assert a known false gameplay fact or allow an unverified macro.
operator_contract.verified: Registry entry with required evidence -> true; missing/unverified -> false. Does not prove the profile is currently active.
operator_contract.contains: Membership in a plain local preference array.
operator_contract.snapshot_valid: Same current generation, increasing seq, monotonic clock checked and snapshot age <= 500 ms; invalid/absent -> false.
operator_contract.valid_local_aim_latch: host.localAimLatch.active plus matching generation/inputContextEpoch. This is command intent; aiming observation remains unchanged.
operator_contract.has_reliable_prompt: At least one visible known-true prompt with current generation/epoch, fresh unexpired timestamp, known semanticStatus and verified binding/stage. Raw text alone is never sufficient.
operator_contract.has_verified_stage_action: Known stageId plus a verified stageActions record for current actionRef; absent stage -> unknown, unverified record -> false.
operator_contract.has_verified_active_stage_action: A verified active script stage with a concrete verified action binding; no current stage -> unknown.
operator_contract.capability_or_pinned_action: Check listed actions against explicit fresh capability/stage records or a local pin; a pin exposes a labeled control but does not validate or execute its binding.
operator_contract.has_pinned_context_action: Local pin for a context action; affects visibility only, not semanticAllowed or binding verification.

preflight: If hostInvalid=true: release all sources, render host-safe controls, no guest auto profile.
If host keyboard/task pad owns input: release displaced semantic owners and render the requested raw panel; never pretend guest ui has changed.
If snapshot invalid: immediately invalidate semantic epoch and release its held buttons, latches, repeats, axes, mouse deltas and wheels, then choose UNKNOWN or deliberate manual raw mode.
Manual profile only changes layout. Host invalid/panel ownership and confirmed guest modal ownership take precedence; never enable unverified semantic macros from a manual selection.
resolver.match_rule: Select first predicate == true. unknown is not a match; continue to a safe less-specific candidate. UNKNOWN is the final unconditional fallback.
resolver.specificity: Explicit UI page before gameplay; turret before passenger; subtype before generic; sniper/aim before FIREARM fallback. All gameplay candidates are suppressed while a reliable guest UI owns input.
resolver.manual_semantics: A manual layout may use deliberate raw controls while telemetry is unknown, but all guest bindings still need declared backend support and macros still require verified semantics.
resolver.normal_commit: Two consecutive successful compatible snapshots before visual profile commit. This debounce never delays safety release of a context known to have lost ownership.
resolver.modifier_stage: Resolve a base profile first, then evaluate modifiers against activeProfileId. Slot arbitration runs after predicates; a true modifier does not imply a free slot.
resolver.stable_bindings: On aiming/reloading echoes preserve unchanged pointer binding owners; never releaseAll merely because FOOT_FIREARM -> FOOT_AIM if aim/fire bindings stay identical.
resolver.loading_vs_unknown: Missing player/world queries are UNKNOWN. LOADING requires an explicit known loading/startup observation; known guest startup UI wins before LOADING.

staleness_and_recovery.release_scope: Always release all semantic touch owners, including digital hold fire, pedals, aim toggle/latch, sprint, wheels and control-axis injection. Stop semantic repeat timers.
staleness_and_recovery.raw_scope: A deliberate raw-panel input does not require a gameplay classifier. Preserve it only while host/input owner/session remain valid; all raw inputs still clear on focus loss, close panel, context-generation replacement or global collapse.
staleness_and_recovery.no_rearm: Do not resume old semantic holds when telemetry recovers; require a new Down or explicit local latch activation.
staleness_and_recovery.failed_required_field: Degrade only affected classification/semantics; an optional missing prompt collector must not invalidate every ordinary gameplay observation.

modifiers.policy: Append, never displace pedals, flight yaw, submarine elevation or held controls. Cases are mutually exclusive per resolved equipment profile; do not infer attach A111 from one key. Unverified stage stays unresolved with task-pad/raw access.

A153 is a checklist family, never an executable binding. Fill one exact existing placeholder or append T1; no swapping with S5/S2. Multiple simultaneous task actions/axes require a registered explicit task profile or SCRIPT task pad; unparsed text opens raw access and does not become a guessed action.
Hide gameplay controls, release old gameplay input, route raw guest keys/mouse; close clears latches and restores latest state/prefs, not old held actions.
Provide 19 SCRIPT channels including continuous axes/triggers; group/stage mapping must be verified; keyboard alone is not an analog fallback.

slot_arbitration.task_placeholder: non_executable_until_exact_binding_resolved; existing placeholder has priority over T1; no duplicate
slot_arbitration.overflow: Never truncate required axes or urgent actions. A task needing more simultaneous inputs must register an explicit tested task layout or use task pad; mark that task not yet adapted.

geometryNotes: D-pad center adjusted to (80,124), arm 48vp; four 44vp buttons have positive separation.
LT/RT use 44x80vp continuous vertical hit regions at y=12..92, separate from bumpers.
Stick bounds are full 128x128vp hit rectangles; collision verification includes their entire rectangular bounds.
LS/RS are separate 44vp buttons, not hidden presses inside the sticks.
Host close/menu controls must be placed outside these hit regions; reserved optional top-right host button rectangle is (586,10,44,44).
Thumb control locations have no gameplay meanings; all events preserve SCRIPT channel identity.

interaction.axisSignStatus: Screen-space positive-Y-down is the layout convention; verify conversion to guest axes per binding/profile before execution.
interaction.pointer_cancel: Release only that pointer; global invalidation releases all channels.

semantic_context_invalidation.raw_sources: Do not cancel deliberately-held raw keyboard or physical input merely because a gameplay query failed; global loss/collapse/close still clears all sources.
semantic_context_invalidation.generation_change: Global all-source release; stale-query-only raw exception does not apply across a replaced guest.
